verdict.rationale: Many INPI guidance pages on www.inpi.fr (filing trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau, directives, DG decisions) were captured as docs, which suggests the main guidance surface is readable. However, a keyless GET to INPI's data.inpi.fr portal returned HTTP 403, so at least part of the public estate blocks keyless agents at the front door. There is no direct probe of www.inpi.fr confirming the absence of a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. Missing for 10: an explicit keyless-agent probe of the www.inpi.fr guidance pages showing a 200 response with server-rendered content, confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot wall is used, and keyless reachability of the data.inpi.fr surface.
